Four comments

James Betagh

One of O’Carolan’s famous tune, in 2 parts : the first in 2/2 (not a reel), followed by a jig, posted here in the original key of G dorian.
Enjoy !

↳ Posted by Moxhe on March 16th, 2017.

James Betagh, X:4

The slow part of the air, in Eminor.

↳ Posted by UPipes & harp on March 25th, 2024.

James Betagh, X:5

Version 4 transposed to GMajor for Uilleann Pipes

↳ Posted by UPipes & harp on March 20th, 2025.

James Betagh, X:6

The Jig part, played after the air. One sharp.
